# Description of Changes

## Risk level: Medium

This is a medium risk change because it changes the behaviour of existing features but does not require a refactor on the consumer's part. This includes internal changes to the code that have observable effects. It must pass the CI checks in order for changes to be merged and deployed.

## Type of Change

The type of changes made can be found on the labels associated with the pull request. The exact changes made can be found under the commits tab.
